name: offline-toolkit
description: Offline desktop toolkit: image resizer, document converter, image to editable design, passport photos. Personal use.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:py && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/bundle-python-win.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never

author: Offline Toolkit (personal use)
